rationale: Both independently converge on the same real bug (fork_rng's device_type defaulting to "cuda" mishandles non-CUDA devices) and the same NPU-regression risk from widening to `!= "cpu"`, plus the FL2VA/Ref2VA doc copy-paste error — strong cross-validated precision for both, though neither recalls the ground-truth reviewer's specific 'use current_omni_platform.device' suggestion (Y gestures at an existing platform-helper precedent, giving it a slight recall edge). X presents its findings in a cleaner, better-triaged (Blocking/Should-fix/Nits) format with copy-pasteable fixes, making it more immediately actionable than Y's dense citation-heavy paragraphs and extraneous automation artifacts (task/mode fields, skill-candidate section).
